theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_atomic_transversal
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν σ : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → Module.finrank ℝ V = n → σ (Vᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → σ K < ∞) → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν A = ∫⁻ t in (V : Set (Euclid P)), σ ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[n]) → (∀ᵐ y ∂ν, ENNReal.ofReal c ≤ liminf (fun r : ℝ => ν (ball y r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)) → ∃ Z : Set (Euclid P), Z.Countable ∧ Z ⊆ (Vᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) ∧ (∀ w ∈ Z, ENNReal.ofReal c ≤ σ {w}) ∧ ν = Measure.sum (fun w : Z => σ {(w : Euclid P)} • (μHE[n]).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - w ∈ V})
